name: Demilich Skull
disable: DC 26 Arcana check, DC 26 Occultism check, DC 26 Nature check, or DC 26 Religion check to counteract the skull's Broken Gems

items.name: Broken Gems
items.text:
Trigger A living creature approaches within 10 feet of the skull

---
Effect The spirits haunting the skull activate one of the skull's ruined gemstones, casting one of the following four spells determined randomly:
- Cast into Time, DC 26 Fortitude save
- Chain Lightning, DC 26 basic Reflex save (8d12 electricity damage)
- Fireball (6th), DC 26 basic Reflex save (12d6 fire damage)
- Spellwrack, DC 26 Will save (2d12 persistent,force or 2*2d12 persistent,force damage)
The saving throw DC for any spell is 26.

text: The skull of a defeated demilich is haunted by souls of the demilich's victims.
